_comment: Hand-labeled sanity-check pairs for NLI classification. Synthetic text; labels reflect plausible textual relationships, NOT scientific truth or model quality. expected scores are what the deterministic fake classifier is scripted to produce (plumbing validation only, circular by construction). 'split' separates development pairs (dev) from held-out reporting pairs (test). uncertain = max score < 0.6 or hedges present.
